'''Shrinker Beetle''' is a normal [[Monsters|Enemy]] found in the [[Overgrowth]].

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Shrinker Beetle}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Shrinker
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies {{BD2|Shrink (Enemy)|Shrink}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Shrink (Enemy)
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Chomp
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (7;{{Asc2|9|8}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Stomp
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (13;{{Asc2|9|14}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always opens with {{Int2|Shrinker Beetle|Shrinker}}, then alternates between {{Int2|Shrinker Beetle|Chomp}} and {{Int2|Shrinker Beetle|Stomp}}.

== Notes ==
* {{KW2|Osty}} is not affected by {{BD2|Shrink}} and deals full damage with his own Attack cards.

== Trivia ==
* The Shrinker Beetle resembles the {{R|Preserved Insect}} from ''Slay the Spire'', which made [[Elites]] appear smaller.
** However, shrinking Elites this way indicated a reduction in their HP, not their attack damage.
* {{P2|Beetle Juice}} presumably is sourced from Shrinker Beetles, since it has an identical effect to the {{BD2|Shrink}} debuff (albeit with a limited duration).
